rows.context_and_review_note: Normalized retry adverb to ⴷⵉⵖ, consistent with reviewed strings. Retained initial ⵙ ⵓⵙⵜⴰⵍ as according to the estimate: the excess is estimated, not a measured allocation failure or a guaranteed future failure. The current working-RAM limit is distinguished from disk space; smallest output, dimensions alone insufficient, close other open files OR prepare a smaller source before retry, and unchanged assembly are preserved. Relative ⵉⵎⵥⵉⵏ and explicit ⵅⴼ ⵜⴰ preserve smaller-source comparison; feminine finite ⵜⵇⵇⵉⵎ agrees with assembly. At the exact base, AssemblyActivity.kt outputSizeDialog obtains renderer.suggested(previous), displays this warning on null and returns before controls or makeOutput. AssemblyRenderer.kt suggested returns null only when fits(ImageDimensions(1,1)) fails. That one-pixel case cannot exceed MAX_BITMAP_PIXELS: the failure is the estimatedBytes comparison against the current workingBytes allowance. The estimate includes output/resident pixels plus source decoding/compositing reserve even at this minimum. This is conservative admission, not proof that all actual renders necessarily fail. Neither branch mutates assembly images, layout or crop. The same dialog can follow an output allocation/size failure; render recycles only its independent output and temporary decoded bitmaps. No unconditional promise that closing documents or using a smaller source will succeed is added.
